name: Range-boundary breakout retest
hypothesis: After a close beyond the prior 48-bar range, the first pullback within 2-12 bars that holds the frozen boundary (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back beyond it offers entry; stop 0.5 ATR through the boundary; target 2R.

entry.long: since(cross_above(close, highest(high,48)[1])) >= 2 and since(cross_above(close, highest(high,48)[1])) <= 12 and low <= valuewhen(cross_above(close, highest(high,48)[1]), highest(high,48)[1]) + 0.1*atr(14) and close > valuewhen(cross_above(close, highest(high,48)[1]), highest(high,48)[1]) and close > open
entry.short: since(cross_below(close, lowest(low,48)[1])) >= 2 and since(cross_below(close, lowest(low,48)[1])) <= 12 and high >= valuewhen(cross_below(close, lowest(low,48)[1]), lowest(low,48)[1]) - 0.1*atr(14) and close < valuewhen(cross_below(close, lowest(low,48)[1]), lowest(low,48)[1]) and close < open
